events.title: IT THINKS! Gameplay Loop: From Logic Gates to Your Own GPU
events.summary: This broadcast loops a 20-minute cut of IT THINKS! played from a fresh save. Every few minutes it jumps between the start, the middle and the end of the campaign, so even a short visit shows the whole arc: placing your first NAND gate, building adders and memory, writing programs for a CPU you wired yourself, and finally running kernels on a GPU of your own design.The footage is pre-recorded gameplay of the full game, with its own music and sound. No commentary.

events.title: Demo Update: Community Puzzles Now Live
events.summary: The latest update for the demo is now available, introducing full support for community-generated content.New Features:Create & Share: Build your own custom puzzles and share them with the community.Play & Rate: Discover, play, and evaluate puzzles created by other players.Custom Lists: Curate, organize, and save your favorite community puzzles into your own lists.Please share any feedback, bug reports, or suggestions in the community hub or discussion boards.

events.title: Daily Challenges & Customer Orders Are Now in the Demo!
events.summary: Hi everyone, Based on your feedback, I’ve added daily challenges and customer orders to the demo! Put your engineering skills to work by designing chips for your customers’ devices, or take on daily puzzles and compete with other players on the leaderboards. Daily challenges unlock after completing the first 10 campaign levels. Thanks for playing and helping me improve the game. If you have any thoughts on the new content, I’d love to hear them! Enjoy!

events.title: Two Games, One Programming Fest!
events.summary: We’re joining Steam Programming Fest with IT THINKS! and IT MOVES!🧠 IT THINKS! — Start with logic gates and build your own GPU.🤖 IT MOVES! — Build your own robot, program it, and bring it to life.Whether you enjoy designing circuits or making robots move, we’d love to see what you create.Check out both games on Steam, wishlist your favorites, and let us know what you think!
